name: word
title: Mind's word
owns: The single decision intake: held questions, exact answers with the source each rests on, their dispositions and the close of a moot question. It keeps no store of its own and persists through the Pool: it mints the question, decision-round and card identities, checks who brings each request and the evidence a review submission rests on, and makes exactly one hive-pool request per mutating operation, as a handoff under its own request identity, so its replay is the Pool's. It writes no record, receipt or event itself.

commands.name: hive-word
commands.purpose: Holds, revisions, exact answers, their release or completion, the close of a moot question, and verification of the Mind's word.

test_scope: Complete rounds, authorized answers, deduplication and unresolved holds. From stage 2: one handoff per operation, replayed by the digest of the original request before any check and racing retries given one outcome; a worker refused; a review submission checked against its round file; an unreconciled answer returned held; verification that reads the record and never the reference, an authority standing only on the answer applied at the revision it names.
